gnosh prompt show

  List gnosh's texts to the model, or print one as it is sent. The list says
  where each text goes and how large it is, and which are yours. With a name,
  the text in force is printed, and what it is, when it is sent and where it
  came from are said on standard error, so that the text alone can be kept in
  a file.

  Not built yet in this build of gnosh: typing it stops with a message that
  says so.

Usage
  gnosh prompt show [flags] [name]

Flags
  -h, --help
      Show help: gnosh's, or after a command's name that command's.
